summary: Interactive OMP, Claude, and Codex agents use the managed launch wrapper selected by their runtime profile, including explicit provider executable overrides

replay.detail: No graph replay; executable selection happens in the driver before launch.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Managed OMP, Claude, and Codex launches require personas.launch.<persona>.harnessBin in the runtime profile. AGENT_PERSONA defaults to generalist only when unset. Explicit executable overrides no longer bypass the managed wrapper.

manual.detail: Rollout dependency: do not upgrade a host to a Fractal release containing this change until that host has activated a runtime profile with personas.launch.<persona>.harnessBin for its managed seats. Read AGENT_RUNTIME_PROFILE when set, otherwise the stable HOME-relative coding-agent-runtime Nix profile; missing profile, persona key, or wrapper refuses new managed launches.

recovery.detail: Correct the runtime profile or install the named wrapper before retrying a refused launch.
